cases.prompt: We go live next week. Set up logging, error tracking, health checks and alerts for this Next.js/Supabase app on Vercel.
expected: Asks once for critical journeys, vendor/DSN availability and notification channel
Plan table posted and approved before changes
lib/logger.ts with redaction + request context; console.* replaced in minimal diffs; no-console lint rule
/api/health (no deps) and /api/health/deep (bearer, timeouts, 503 on down) added with tests
Alert rules each have threshold, window, tier, runbook, owner; SLO table per journey
Synthetic failure verified to fire an alert on preview

cases.prompt: We already have Sentry wired. Add health endpoints and alerts only.
expected: Inventories existing Sentry config and keeps it
Adds only health routes and alert rules; no logger rewrite unless console.* found
Tags requestId in existing Sentry setup if missing, as a minimal diff
Asks once for critical journeys and alert channel
Does not invent SLO numbers; marks them to be baselined with owner
